jumbled_sentences.S: Later deep inelastic scattering experiments at particle accelerators triumphantly confirmed the physical reality of quarks.

fixed_end: 6: The quark model became an essential pillar of the Standard Model of particle physics.

jumbled_sentences.S: Their combined theoretical and experimental work earned them the 1902 Nobel Prize in Physics.

fixed_end: 6: The Zeeman effect remains a vital diagnostic tool for measuring magnetic fields in stellar atmospheres and sunspots.
